opportunities.title: Desarrollador Experto para Sistema de Generación de Leads por Whats...
opportunities.description: Se busca un desarrollador experimentado para crear un sistema integral de generación y gestión de leads a través de WhatsApp, diseñado específicamente para una agencia de seguros en California, enfocada en el mercado hispano. El sistema debe operar 100% en español y utilizar la API oficial de WhatsApp Business / Meta Cloud API para gestionar un canal de WhatsApp y conversaciones 1:1. Funcionalidades clave requeridas: 1. Captura de Leads: Implementación de un mecanismo para capturar leads mediante enlaces/QR y anuncios click-to-WhatsApp. Estos deben iniciar una conversación automática que recoja información esencial del prospecto (nombre, teléfono, ciudad e interés específico en seguros de vida, plan funerario o gastos finales). 2. Bot de Calificación con IA: Desarrollo de un bot conversacional impulsado por inteligencia artificial en español. Este bot deberá realizar entre 3 y 5 preguntas para calificar al prospecto y, posteriormente, agendar una cita, integrándose con un sistema de calendario. 3. Integración con GoHighLevel (CRM): El sistema debe integrarse con GoHighLevel para crear o actualizar contactos, asignar etiquetas relevantes, gestionar el pipeline de ventas y disparar automatizaciones de seguimiento predefinidas. 4. Gestión del Canal de WhatsApp: Capacidades para la publicación programada de contenido, el uso de plantillas de mensajes aprobadas por Meta y la difusión segmentada a listas de prospectos, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas de Meta y los requisitos de opt-in. 5. Panel de Control: Creación de un panel de control intuitivo que muestre métricas clave como leads por fuente, tasa de respuesta, citas agendadas y permita la asignación automática de leads (round-robin) a un equipo de 20 agentes. Entregables esperados: * Código fuente completo del sistema. * Documentación técnica detallada en español. * Sesión de capacitación de 1 hora para el equipo. * Soporte técnico post-implementación durante 30 días. Se valorará la experiencia comprobable en proyectos similares, especialmente aquellos que involucren la API de WhatsApp Cloud, GoHighLevel y el desarrollo de bots con IA (ej. OpenAI/Claude). Se solicita incluir en la propuesta ejemplos de trabajos previos, el tiempo estimado para la finalización del proyecto y el presupuesto total. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Inteligencia Artificial Tamaño del proyecto: Pequeño

opportunities.title: Vehicle Service Management Systems.
opportunities.description: I’m building a complete management platform for a mixed vehicle repair workshop and need an experienced developer (or small team) to take it from concept to production. The goal is simple: everything our staff now scribble on paper—job cards, parts used, customer signatures—must live in a single, real-time system that also talks to our customers through both SMS and WhatsApp. Core workflow • A vehicle is checked in on a phone or tablet, creating a digital job card that follows it through every bay until final delivery. • Mechanics update status, add photos and notes, and trigger parts withdrawals as they work. • Stock levels adjust automatically; low-stock alerts fire and a purchase order can be raised on the spot. • The moment an estimate is approved, one click turns it into a tax-ready invoice that can be paid online. • Owners open a dashboard and instantly see today’s revenue, who is the most productive tech, and which services make us money. Mobile use All key modules—job cards, repair updates, booking calendar, customer messaging, inventory, invoices and payments—must function smoothly on staff smartphones (Android and iOS). A responsive web portal for desktops is fine for back-office tasks, but the floor runs on phones. Customer communication Automated reminders, booking confirmations and repair-status notifications go out via both SMS and WhatsApp, using whichever channel the customer responds to first. High-level deliverables 1. Database & API architecture that supports multi-device real-time sync. 2. Web admin and mobile (or fully responsive PWA) front-ends for staff. 3. Customer notification engine integrated with SMS and WhatsApp gateways. 4. Inventory module with low-stock rules and purchase-order generation. 5. Estimate-to-invoice flow with payment gateway hookup and basic tax logic. 6. Owner dashboard with daily revenue, productivity and service profitability metrics. 7. Documentation, test data, and hand-over training session. Acceptance criteria • Sub-60-second load/login on 4G mobile. • Offline-first job card edits that sync once connectivity returns. • 100 % of booking and status alerts delivered via at least one channel (SMS or WhatsApp) and logged. • All invoices export correctly in standard tax format (PDF + CSV). • Clear, commented codebase and setup instructions that a new dev can stand up in under an hour. If you have deployed similar workshop, field-service or inventory systems, show me. I’m happy to discuss stack recommendations as long as they meet the speed, reliability and mobile usability targets above.

The goal is simple: everything our staff now scribble on paper—job cards, parts used, customer signatures—must live in a single, real-time system that also talks to our customers through both SMS and WhatsApp. Core workflow • A vehicle is checked in on a phone or tablet, creating a digital job card that follows it through every bay until final delivery. • Mechanics update status, add photos and notes, and trigger parts withdrawals as they work. • Stock levels adjust automatically; low-stock alerts fire and a purchase order can be raised on the spot. • The moment an estimate is approved, one click turns it into a tax-ready invoice that can be paid online. • Owners open a dashboard and instantly see today’s revenue, who is the most productive tech, and which services make us money. Mobile use All key modules—job cards, repair updates, booking calendar, customer messaging, inventory, invoices and payments—must function smoothly on staff smartphones (Android and iOS). A responsive web portal for desktops is fine for back-office tasks, but the floor runs on phones. Customer communication Automated reminders, booking confirmations and repair-status notifications go out via both SMS and WhatsApp, using whichever channel the customer responds to first. High-level deliverables 1. Database & API architecture that supports multi-device real-time sync. 2. Web admin and mobile (or fully responsive PWA) front-ends for staff. 3. Customer notification engine integrated with SMS and WhatsApp gateways. 4. Inventory module with low-stock rules and purchase-order generation. 5. Estimate-to-invoice flow with payment gateway hookup and basic tax logic. 6. Owner dashboard with daily revenue, productivity and service profitability metrics. 7. Documentation, test data, and hand-over training session. Acceptance criteria • Sub-60-second load/login on 4G mobile. • Offline-first job card edits that sync once connectivity returns. • 100 % of booking and status alerts delivered via at least one channel (SMS or WhatsApp) and logged. • All invoices export correctly in standard tax format (PDF + CSV). • Clear, commented codebase and setup instructions that a new dev can stand up in under an hour. If you have deployed similar workshop, field-service or inventory systems, show me. I’m happy to discuss stack recommendations as long as they meet the speed, reliability and mobile usability targets above."
requirements_list: Requisitos técnicos solicitados: PHP, Mobile App Development, Android, C# Programming, MySQL, HTML, Database Development, Web Development, API Development, iOS.
Presupuesto asignado por el demandante: INR 75,000 - 150,000.
Propuestas recibidas hasta ahora: 167 ofertas.

opportunities.title: Glycol & EO/PO Defoamer Formulation
opportunities.description: I head R & D at Shree Jalaram Corporation, Ankleshwar, where we already manufacture a full range of silicone and non-silicone antifoams. The next gap in our portfolio is a set of completely new glycol-based and EO/PO-based defoamers aimed primarily at wastewater applications and other general-process industries. What I need now is a formulator who can take the project from a blank sheet to a production-ready recipe. I will provide access to our current raw-material suppliers, lab equipment, and performance data from competing products; you would contribute the surfactant chemistry know-how, screening methodology, and iterative optimisation. Key deliverables • Lab-scale formulations with exact percentages and raw-material grades • Step-by-step manufacturing procedure that fits our existing reactors and mixers • QC parameters (viscosity, density, Defoamer Efficiency Index, etc.) and corresponding test methods • Benchmark report showing performance in wastewater foaming tests versus at least one market reference • Scale-up guidance to 1 t pilot and full-scale batches, including HSE notes Once the first formula is proven, we can extend the collaboration to food-grade and paint/ink variants, so I’m looking to build a long-term relationship with a practical, results-driven chemist who understands cost targets as well as performance. If this sounds like you, tell me about a similar antifoam you’ve brought to market and which analytical tools (foam-column, Ross-Miles, Waring blender, etc.) you prefer to rely on.

opportunities.title: Multi-Client GST Automation Platform
opportunities.description: I need a cloud-based GST compliance platform built specifically for a CA firm that handles multiple clients and registrations. The application must automate everything from data ingestion to final filing while remaining simple enough for non-technical users on both the firm side and the client side. Core workflow • Data capture: import sales and purchase data from Excel/CSV, accept invoices dropped into a browser-based client portal, and pull ledgers directly through the GSTN using an approved API. Manual file uploads from the portal must work interchangeably with the API so we can fall back whenever the gateway is down. • Return preparation & filing: generate GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B automatically, calculate GST liability and interest, and push the filings through our GST service-provider account. • Reconciliation: match purchase invoices with GSTR-2B, highlight ITC mismatches in real time, and let the user accept, reject, or flag items for follow-up. • Compliance tracking: calendar of due dates, status tracker for each client GSTIN, and colour-coded alerts. • Notice management: log departmental notices, auto-create response tasks, and trigger email/SMS reminders. Client-facing layer Clients log in to a branded portal where they can: – Upload invoices and supporting documents – Receive automatic reminders when data is due – View a concise dashboard of filing status, ITC position, and downloadable reports Firm-side dashboard Role-based access for partners, managers, and data-entry staff with drill-down analytics, workload allocation, and exportable audit logs. Tech expectations • Web stack of your choice (modern JS framework or Django/Laravel are fine) provided it performs well with large CSVs. • Secure multi-tenant architecture, 2-factor authentication, encrypted data at rest. • GSTN API integration and file-parser modules must be cleanly separated so we can maintain them independently. • Detailed documentation, unit tests, and a staging URL for UAT are mandatory. Deliverables 1. Source code in a private repository 2. Deployed SaaS instance on our AWS or Azure account 3. Install/upgrade guide and API keys wired up 4. Two rounds of post-launch bug fixes (30 days) Acceptance will be based on: successful filing of test returns through both API and manual upload paths, accurate ITC reconciliation against sample 2B data, and passing of our security review. If you have built tax or fintech products before, that will help us move quickly—send over a short demo or repo link and your estimated timeline.

Only apply if you have managed at least Rs 2 Lakhs/month ad spend with proof.Don't send generic proposals - Proposals without case studies will be rejected. Looking for a long-term partner, not one-time campaign. Thanks, Abhishek Founder, ALPHA Pimpri, Pune

opportunities.title: Dual-Platform Lead Generation Campaign
opportunities.description: I need an experienced performance marketer to plan, build, and optimise a coordinated campaign across Google Ads and Meta (Facebook & Instagram). The single objective is clear: generate a steady flow of qualified leads that pick up the phone or tap straight into WhatsApp, not just fill out a form. Here’s what I have in mind: – Structure search and display campaigns on Google to capture high-intent traffic and pair them with compelling click-to-call or click-to-WhatsApp extensions. – Run precise Meta ads—lead formats, click-to-WhatsApp, or conversation campaigns—that retarget site visitors and reach fresh look-alike audiences. – Align creative, copy, and ad sequencing so prospects see a seamless message from search through social. – Track every call and WhatsApp chat via conversion tags, Google Analytics, and Meta Events Manager, then continually refine bids, audiences, and creatives to lower cost-per-lead. I will provide existing brand assets and access to current ad accounts. You’ll deliver live campaigns, tracking setup, and short weekly performance summaries highlighting leads, cost per lead, and optimisation steps taken. If this end-to-end lead-generation focus sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s talk strategy and timelines.

opportunities.title: Automated full Intraloral mouth imaging and tooth surface scanning system
opportunities.description: I’m developing a capstone project at King Abdulaziz University that blends mechanical motion with electrical controls to form a small-scale automated communication and control device. My concept is outlined, but I need a hands-on collaborator who can turn that concept into both a solid research report and a fully functioning prototype. The work spans mechanical and electrical domains: confirming design assumptions through literature review, running sizing and stress calculations, selecting sensors, motors, and a suitable microcontroller or PLC, and then integrating everything into a working assembly. From CAD layouts and wiring diagrams to firmware that drives the control logic, each piece must be documented so it can satisfy academic submission requirements as well as a live demonstration. Key deliverables • Research summary with cited references that validates design choices • Detailed mechanical drawings and 3-D CAD files • Electrical schematics, bill of materials, and control algorithms • Programmed controller (Arduino, ESP32, or comparable) with sensor/actuator integration • Assembled, tested prototype ready for on-campus presentation • Final report covering methodology, test data, and recommendations I’m comfortable iterating together over SolidWorks or Inventor for the mechanical side and Altium, KiCad, or Eagle for PCB work, while code can run in C/C++ or MicroPython—whatever achieves stable, real-time control. Remote collaboration is fine; just be prepared for clear progress meetings and to share native design files so I can learn from the process. If you have prior mechatronics or automation builds under your belt, especially those involving communication or supervisory control, your insight will be invaluable for meeting the university’s performance criteria and project timeline.

opportunities.title: Setup of an automated AI system on CHAPGPT PLUS (requiring average computer skills) - Gentle training for Old people with No computer skills
opportunities.description: IMPORTANT : To prevent wasting time with autobot make sure to read the entire text and include the phrase found in the beginning of your reply Overview: We are seeking a person who combines intermediate technical skills with with the right attitude and respect of old school communication style. You will help highly accomplished, senior philanthropists to build a "Living Legacy AI Library." Allowing selected people or organizations to benefit from this substantial sum of knowledge and wisdom helping to resolve major problems by being able to have a conversation with the AI and debating topics in various field in a format that should be attractive to the younger generation Your job has two parts: 1 The Builder: You will perform the initial setup of an automated AI system on CHAPGPT PLUS (requiring average computer skills). 2 The assistant : You will guide and hand-hold users (who have none or very basic level tech skills) so they can operate the system easily by simple action like just clicking "Approve" or "Allow etc.. The Ideal Candidate Persona: • Technical Skill: Competent with MAC-PC , Android, ChatGPT custom setups, and basic file automation tools. • Temperament: Patient, warm, encouraging, and deeply respectful of "old-school" values. • Communication: Speaks at a calm, medium speed. Articulates words clearly. • Environment: Conducts all video/audio sessions from a completely quiet, professional space. No background noise allowed. • Values: Shows respect for Senior experts who have spent 50+ years solving problems and now want to leave a legacy by sharing at no cost their hard earned expertise with the world…. Every session must be encouraging and feel like a prestigious, pleasurable experience Key Job Responsibilities: • Phase 1 (Setup): Configure the 4-Phase AI Swarm (The Thinker AI for voice debates, The Auditor AI for text cleanup, The Storage AI for PDF generation, and The Boardroom AI for meeting prep). • Phase 2 (Onboarding): Share with the founder of LL-AI (your first expert elder) how to seamlessly and efficiently use the system. You will then refine the training process based on his feedback. • Phase 3 (Scale): You will replicate this program by sharing and hand-holding subsequent senior experts using the same refined process. • Phase 4 (PR - growing LL-AI): If you have the proper profile and really enjoy dealing with all those expert elders you may be invited to be instrumental in developing LL-AI in all aspects such as coordinating with the users making sure they will get the very best benefits Feel free to ask any questions without restrictions as it is important that you have a clear understanding of what are the expectations We then will suggest a live audio/Video conversation to Thailand (where the founder and first expert elder reside) Please include at beginning of your reply "I have read your requirements|" - Looking forward talking to you

opportunities.title: Complete Multi-Unit Building Design
opportunities.description: I’m preparing to develop a new multi-unit residential building and need someone who can carry the project from the first sketch right through to fully coordinated construction drawings. That means guiding me through site planning, massing studies, detailed floor layouts, facades, and all the structural design and calculations required for permitting and safe construction. We’ll start with concept options so I can evaluate unit mix, circulation, parking and overall feasibility. From there, I’ll need full architectural drawings in AutoCAD or Revit, a coordinated BIM model, and structural plans that meet local code, including foundation, framing, load calculations and material specs. Civil, MEP and energy-code coordination can be folded in if you have that capability, but the core scope is architectural plus structural. Deliverables • Schematic design package with 3D visuals • Planning-submission set (site plan, elevations, sections) • Full construction drawings (GA plans, details, schedules) • Structural calculations report and stamped drawings • A final coordinated PDF + native CAD/BIM files I’ll review each stage for functionality, compliance and buildability; sign-off at schematic, design-development and CD milestones will release the next tranche of work. If you have a portfolio of similar multi-unit residential projects and can collaborate smoothly over video calls and shared cloud folders, let’s talk timelines and get started.

Two quick rounds of minor tweaks should be included to make sure everything is perfectly aligned and legible.

opportunities.title: Interactive Developer Portfolio Website
opportunities.description: The project is to build a modern, fully responsive portfolio site that immediately highlights my work as a Python Full-Stack and React developer while also reflecting my passion for AI. I want recruiters and potential collaborators to land on the site, scan visually engaging project cards, and jump straight to live demos with a single click—this is the primary goal. Design direction Think sleek e-commerce UI: generous white space, attractive cards with soft shadows, subtle color gradients, and smooth micro-interactions that feel polished on desktop, tablet, and mobile. Navigation must stay simple and sticky, keeping every section—About Me, Technical Skills, Projects, Work Experience, Education, Training, Achievements, and Contact—one or two taps away. Projects section Each card needs: • Project image • Short summary • Technology stack tags • Live demo link (must open in new tab) Performance counts; heavy assets should be optimized so pages still load quickly on 4G mobile. Mini-game twist I’d like an optional, lightweight retro 2D mini-game embedded—or launched in a modal—so visitors can play for fun. A clear “Skip Game / Go to Portfolio” button must let recruiters bypass the game and view the site immediately. Cross-device & accessibility Everything—buttons, links, forms—must work flawlessly with mouse, keyboard, and touch. Font choices and color contrast should follow WCAG guidelines, and animations should respect “prefers-reduced-motion” where possible. Maintainability Use clean, component-based code (React or Next.js fits well, but I’m open). Keep styling modular (CSS Modules, Styled-Components, or Tailwind are fine) so I can expand sections later without rewiring the layout. Deliverables 1. Source code in a Git repository with clear setup instructions. 2. Deployed site (GitHub Pages, Vercel, Netlify, or similar) linked from the repo. 3. Read-me covering build commands, how to add new projects, and how to disable or update the mini-game. Acceptance criteria • Lighthouse performance ≥ 90 on desktop and mobile. • Project cards render exactly as specified and open the correct live demos. • Mini-game loads under 2 seconds and can be skipped instantly. • No console errors; all internal/external links resolve. • Layout verified on Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge; breakpoints for ≥1280 px, 768–1279 px, ≤767 px. If this aligns with your expertise, the repo and deployment links will mark the job complete.

opportunities.title: Secure Funding for New Startup - 27/10/2026 00:40 EDT
opportunities.description: # Fundraising & Strategic Investment Partner for XAVOT — Angels, VCs, Grants & Startup Funding ## About XAVOT XAVOT is an early-stage startup founded by Dushyant Kumar, a student entrepreneur from India. We are currently at the concept and validation stage, working to turn our vision into a focused, commercially viable venture. Our long-term ambition is to build an innovation-driven technology company focused on solving real-world problems through engineering, research, automation and deep technology. Our broader vision includes creating opportunities for students, innovators, engineers and companies to collaborate on real-world challenges and develop practical solutions. As an initial direction, we are exploring opportunities in the automotive sector, including real-world vehicle experience research, customer-driven product improvements and potential approaches to reducing vehicle manufacturing costs. These are areas under exploration, not validated products or proven cost-saving solutions. We are now looking for an experienced fundraising professional or strategic partner who can help us identify suitable funding opportunities and move from concept toward execution. ## Our Immediate Objective Our priority is to identify serious investors, suitable non-dilutive funding opportunities and startup support programs that match XAVOT's current stage, business direction and long-term potential. We are looking for someone who can do more than provide a list of investor names. We need a professional who understands fundraising, has relevant industry connections and can help turn targeted outreach into meaningful conversations and funding opportunities. ## Scope of Work **1. Investor and Funding Research** - Identify and evaluate relevant angel investors, angel networks, seed funds, venture capital firms, strategic investors, startup incubators, accelerators and grant programs. - Prioritize opportunities aligned with early-stage startups, technology, engineering, automotive innovation and deep-tech development. - Document each opportunity's investment thesis, typical ticket size where available, geography, eligibility requirements, application process and relevant contact details. - Distinguish genuinely suitable prospects from generic or unverified leads. **2. Fundraising Strategy and Materials** - Help refine XAVOT's business positioning, funding narrative and proposed use of funds. - Prepare or improve a professional pitch deck, executive summary and one-page startup profile. - Tailor the materials to different investors, grants and accelerator programs. - Help identify a realistic funding target based on the startup's stage, planned activities and resource requirements. **3. Investor Outreach and Relationship Building** - Develop personalized outreach messages for relevant investors and funding organizations. - Use existing professional relationships to secure warm introductions wherever possible. - Manage follow-ups, schedule investor calls and maintain a transparent record of outreach. - Identify opportunities for strategic partnerships, incubation, mentorship and early-stage support in addition to direct capital. **4. Application and Deal Support** - Prepare and coordinate grant, incubator and accelerator applications. - Help us prepare for investor meetings, due diligence questions and funding discussions. - Assist with evaluating term sheets and comparing proposed investment terms, with qualified legal and financial professionals involved where required. - Maintain a live pipeline report showing prospects, communication status, next steps and outcomes. ## Expected Deliverables and Acceptance Criteria 1. **A vetted pipeline of at least 30 relevant funding opportunities**, with documented fit, investment or grant criteria, geography and available contact details. 2. **A professional pitch deck, executive summary and startup one-pager** suitable for submission to relevant investors and funding programs, following our review and approval. 3. **At least three meaningful outreach outcomes within the first two weeks**, consisting of warm introductions to relevant investors or submitted applications to suitable funding programs. All introductions and submissions must be genuine, documented and authorized by XAVOT. 4. **A shared tracking system** using Google Sheets, a CRM or an equivalent tool to record contacts, communications, responses and next steps. 5. **A practical fundraising roadmap** identifying the most promising funding routes, eligibility gaps, required documents and recommended next actions. Initial research and the first set of deliverables should be provided within the first week. The full scope will begin immediately upon agreement and access to the necessary startup information. ## Compensation and Incentives We are open to a performance-oriented collaboration. Our proposed compensation structure is: - An agreed service fee, with the scope, milestones and payment terms established in advance. - Success-based compensation of up to **3% of eligible funding actually secured and received by XAVOT** through the agreed engagement, subject to a written agreement and applicable laws and funding-program rules. The precise calculation, payment trigger, eligible funding sources and treatment of grants versus investment capital will be documented before work begins. Any percentage-based arrangement will be subject to the relevant legal and compliance requirements. We value measurable results, transparent reporting and long-term professional relationships. ## Who Should Apply? We are looking for an individual or team with demonstrable experience in one or more of the following: - Startup fundraising and investor relations. - Angel and seed-stage investor networks. - Grant identification and application management. - Startup accelerators, incubators and government-supported funding programs. - Pitch deck development and fundraising strategy. - Strategic partnerships in technology, engineering, automotive or deep-tech sectors. Applicants with experience helping early-stage or concept-stage startups are particularly encouraged to apply. ## How to Apply Please keep your proposal concise and include: 1. Your relevant fundraising experience and the sectors you specialize in. 2. Examples of funding rounds, grants or investor introductions you have helped secure, with outcomes where verifiable. 3. The investor networks or funding programs you can realistically access. 4. Your proposed first-week action plan. 5. Your preferred service-fee structure and expectations regarding success-based compensation. 6. The tools you use to manage research, outreach and reporting, if relevant. Please do not submit generic lists of investor contacts or promises of guaranteed funding. We value verified relationships, thoughtful targeting, transparent communication and realistic execution. **The objective is to build a credible funding pathway for XAVOT and establish a professional relationship that can grow alongside the company.**

opportunities.title: Cross-Platform Hospital Tycoon Game
opportunities.description: ATTENTION: PLEASE ENSURE YOU READ THE PROJECT REQUIREMENTS AND UNDERSTAND THE ASSETS ART. ANY BOT BID WILL AUTOMATICALLY BE REJECTED ------ >To be verified your ability to work: Please make a prototype demo video and send to me through chat. ANY BID WITHOUT PROOF OF PROTOTYPE WOULD BE REJECTED.. Thank you. --------- I want to turn the pixel-art pack at https://gainpips.itch.io/hospital-staff-patients into a full mobile hospital-management tycoon for both Android and iPhone/iPad. The art set should be used exactly as it is, so the code and UI need to respect its scale, palette, and proportions. Core gameplay revolves around three intertwined loops: players build and expand new hospital rooms, hire and schedule doctors, nurses, and other staff, then treat incoming patients while continually upgrading equipment to keep satisfaction and profits rising. Smooth drag-and-drop room placement, incremental unlocking of facilities, and clear resource dashboards are essential to make that flow satisfying on touch screens. I am happy with any well-documented engine—Unity, Godot, or a comparable cross-platform framework—as long as performance is solid on mid-range phones. Deliverables • Playable builds: Android APK + iOS TestFlight/IPA • Complete, compile-ready project source with comments • Brief setup guide so I can open, tweak, and export future versions myself Acceptance criteria will be a fully functional tutorial level that demonstrates room construction, staff hiring, and at least one diagnosis-treatment-discharge cycle while keeping the original asset visuals intact.

opportunities.title: Urgent: Smart, Organized Generalist VA needed (Marketing, Design, Automation, Vibe Coding)
opportunities.description: ****IF YOU DO NOT have EXCELLENT written and spoken English (without AI), DO NOT APPLY!***** Highly versatile assistant needed for supporting multiple projects being setup, tested and launched as part of a new venture studio. Skills You'll need to be: 1. Highly organised - you do highly detailed spreadsheets and can run deep analysis work. 2. Design - you are able to use design tools like Figma, Adobe Illustrator etc. (Canva is NOT a proper design tool) 3. Marketing tasks - you can undertake SEO/AEO and social media design and posting tasks 4. Automation - you can assist with setting up marketing automations across social, content so have some familiarity with python 5. Recruitment - you can assist with hiring and recruitment based tasks 6. Basic bookkeeping - you can perform basic bookkeeping tasks in QBO You must rate your skills for each of the skills above (1 - poor knowledge/skill/confidence to 10 - excellent knowledge/skill/confidence). Please ensure you provide the rating to each of the 6 items above in your application. You must have fluent written and spoken English. To be shortlisted please note: 1. We are not using agencies/teams - also 'autobidders' who do not read this job description will be removed. 2. The hourly rate you bid, is the one we accept 3. You will be required for a minimum of 20 hours (2-3 days per week) for a MINIMUM 6 months 4. AI is there to assist you, not do the work for you. If you don't have skills, DO NOT apply as you will be tested and you will fail our tests. While we expect you to use AI, you must understand the tasks you are undertaking without it. 5. You must have access to Claude Pro and aHrefs or SEMrush (paid) yourself. We cannot create multiple accounts under their policies. Free AI tools are unacceptable. The hiring process is as follows: 1. You will be notified that you have been shortlisted. 2. You will need to attend a video interview 3. You will be provided with a 6-month contract and an offer of contract work 4. The work will include a two-week paid trial I look forward to working with a professional who has a proper office setup, is well versed in starting and growing new projects and is curious and actively advancing their skills in one or more of the above areas. NOTE: The first few weeks of your engagement, you'll be doing tasks manually. Creating and posting blogs, social media, backlink building etc. After that, you'll be expected to automate tasks using python/cron based semi and fully autonomous workflows. You'll be given multiple projects to do this for, along with direction and guidance. Thank you.

opportunities.title: Residential HVAC Coordination Drawings
opportunities.description: I need complete HVAC coordination drawings for a residential building. The scope is focused on the air-distribution side, so your layout must clearly show every air duct, grille, register, and vent in relation to the architectural and structural backgrounds. Please deliver a fully coordinated set that is ready for construction approval—clash-free, to scale, and annotated with sizes, elevations, and fitting schedules. I typically review files in DWG and PDF, so provide both formats or let me know early if you prefer another platform. If you already use coordination tools such as AutoCAD, Revit, or Navisworks, mention that in your proposal; I am flexible as long as the final drawings meet industry standards and can be cross-checked against other trades. Let me know your estimated turnaround time and any information you still need from my side (architectural plans, equipment cutsheets, etc.) so we can get started right away.

opportunities.title: Acreditación ISO 17025 en CDA
opportunities.description: Busco apoyo y un equipo para lograr acreditar y poner en marcha un laboratorio de metrologia en Colombia enfocado en CDA logrando acreditarse ante la ONAC Es necesito realizar una auditoría de lo que se tiene de lo que falta corregir analizar y implementar 1. Diseño e implementación del Sistema de Gestión de Calidad (SGC): Documentar procedimientos técnicos, metrológicos y administrativos alineados con la ISO/IEC 17025. Definir la política de calidad, control de documentos, gestión de riesgos y manejo de no conformidades. 2. Aseguramiento de la Trazabilidad Metrológica: Calibrar tus equipos patrón en laboratorios que ya estén acreditados por ONAC o en institutos nacionales de metrología reconocidos internacionalmente (como el INM en Colombia o laboratorios firmantes del acuerdo ILAC). 3. Cálculo e Estimación de la Incertidumbre de Medición: Desarrollar los modelos matemáticos y presupuestos de incertidumbre (bajo la guía GUM) para cada uno de los métodos de calibración que vas a ofrecer. 4. Validación y Verificación de Métodos: Demostrar mediante pruebas técnicas que tus procedimientos de calibración son confiables y repetibles. 5. Participación en Ensayos de Aptitud (Intercomparaciones): Debes participar y tener un desempeño exitoso en rondas de ensayos de aptitud o comparaciones interlaboratorios con otros laboratorios acreditados para demostrar competencia técnica. 6. Solicitud ante el ONAC: Registrarte en el sistema SIPSO de ONAC, radicar la solicitud de acreditación para el esquema de Laboratorios de Calibración (LAC) especificando tu alcance (las magnitudes y rangos exactos que certificarás). Superar las auditorías del ONAC: Etapa 1 (revisión documental del SGC) y Etapa 2 (auditoría in situ en tu laboratorio para evaluar la competencia técnica del personal y la ejecución de las pruebas). 7. Cierre de hallazgos y Otorgamiento: Atender las no conformidades (Plan de Correcciones y Acciones Correctivas - PCAC) si las hay, hasta que el comité de ONAC apruebe la emisión de tu certificado de acreditación oficial.

opportunities.title: Desarrollo de Sistema de Facturación e Inventario Saas y Desktop Hí...
opportunities.description: Desarrollo de una solución integral para gestión financiera y operativa de pequeñas y medianas empresas, combinando una plataforma web SaaS multiempresa y una aplicación desktop offline para uso local. La solución incluye módulos de facturación, control de inventario, clientes, pagos, auditoría y dashboard de métricas, permitiendo gestionar todo el flujo contable y operativo desde una sola plataforma. Características principales: Facturación electrónica con numeración segura y validación de stock. Control de inventario con movimientos de entrada/salida (Kardex). Gestión de clientes, productos y pagos. Módulo de dashboard con indicadores financieros. Soporte multiempresa con aislamiento por tenant. Auditoría de movimientos y trazabilidad de operaciones. Arquitectura híbrida: web en la nube y desktop local, ideal para negocios con o sin internet. Seguridad transaccional con PostgreSQL, RLS y procedimientos almacenados para operaciones críticas. Tecnologías utilizadas: Frontend web: Angular + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS. Desktop: .net 8 + wpf. Backend y base de datos: PostgreSQL / Supabase. Contenedores: Docker. Arquitectura orientada a integridad, seguridad y escalabilidad. Objetivo del proyecto: Crear un sistema moderno, seguro y eficiente para automatizar procesos de facturación, control de inventario y administración de empresas, con una experiencia de usuario intuitiva y una base técnica sólida para crecimiento futuro. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

opportunities.title: Immediate AutoCAD Drawing Revisions
opportunities.description: I already have the full set of CAD drawings for a 743.63 m² pharmaceutical unit and now need a draughtsman who can jump in straight away and finish the job. All the base plans are drafted; your role is pure revision, detailing and final sheet compilation. The scope covers every outstanding item—HVAC duct joint corrections with proper detailing, light-to-switchboard circuitry on the electrical plan, a compliant sprinkler layout with clear escape routes, and then the consolidated sheet layouts. Every adjustment must be checked against India NBC as well as the local fire-department code; I am relying on you to ensure the set is fully rule-compliant for this location. Time is critical. If you can start the moment I share the DWG files and work continuously, I need the finished package tonight or, at the very latest, tomorrow morning. Deliverables • Editable DWG files for each revised sheet • Print-ready PDFs at full scale When you reply, confirm that you are free to begin immediately, quote your total fee, and state the exact delivery time you can commit to. I will award the project as soon as I receive a confident response from someone who can meet this deadline.

opportunities.title: Custom Porsche Engine Swap Mount Design
opportunities.description: I’m mid-way through an engine-swap on my Porsche and need a rock-solid design for the new motor mounts before anything heads to the machine shop. The task is design-only: I want complete drawings and precise measurements that let a fabricator build the mounts without guesswork. Here’s the situation. The donor engine doesn’t share the factory mounting points, so I have to bridge Porsche chassis geometry with the new block’s bosses while maintaining correct driveline angle, adequate clearance for exhaust and steering, and proper vibration isolation. You’ll translate those requirements into a practical mount layout, specify materials, bushing style/durometer, and include any fastener grades or torque specs that are critical. Deliverables • 3D CAD model (STEP or similar) of left and right mounts • Fully dimensioned 2D drawings as PDF/DXF suitable for CNC or manual machining • Brief calculation notes or FEA snapshots demonstrating load capacity and safety factor • Material list with part numbers or generic specs that a fabricator can source locally Acceptance criteria: the model must align with the chassis pick-up points I supply, hold the engine at the factory driveline angle ±0.5°, clear surrounding components by at least 5 mm, and show a minimum 3× safety factor under peak torque loads. If you’ve designed engine-swap mounts before—especially for Porsche platforms—let me know what engines and chassis you handled and which CAD tools you’ll use (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, etc.). Provide a sample drawing if possible so I can gauge clarity. I’m ready to share detailed measurements, photos, and cardboard templates of the engine bay as soon as we start. Let’s create a design that slides straight from screen to steel.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40788633, publicado hace 6 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 15 - 25.

opportunities.title: Engineer Universal Adjustable Strap Mount
opportunities.description: Mechanical Engineer Required – Universal Strap Mounting System with Adjustable Rotational Mechanism We are seeking an experienced mechanical engineer or product designer to develop an innovative mounting and positioning system for attaching an accessory to various types of poles, posts and equipment frames. We have identified an existing product called **GymValet**, which demonstrates the general mounting and adjustable positioning functionality we are looking to achieve. Our objective is to develop our own improved design that offers greater stability, reliability, ease of installation and suitability for commercial manufacturing. ### Reference Material GymValet demonstration video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=coN6_1z4dl8 GymValet product information and installation instructions: https://pages.zogics.com/hubfs/Product%20Sheets%202021/GymValet.pdf These references are provided to illustrate the general mounting concept and functionality. We are seeking an independently engineered design rather than a direct reproduction of the existing product. ### Key Design Objectives - A compact, universal mounting solution that can securely attach to round, square and rectangular poles or equipment frames. - A preference for a single fastening arrangement rather than multiple separate attachment points. - No drilling, screwing into or permanent modification of the equipment. - Non-marking contact surfaces to protect the equipment's finish. - Excellent stability, with no noticeable slipping, rocking or rotation during normal use. - A highly secure fastening system that maintains its holding strength over extended periods without requiring regular adjustment. - An integrated mounting interface that allows an attached accessory to be positioned and securely fixed at various angles. - Simple and efficient installation with minimal tools. - A clean, compact and professional appearance. - Minimal components and potential failure points. - Suitable for cost-effective mass production. ### Design Approach We are open to different materials, fastening methods, locking arrangements and mechanical solutions. We do not want to prescribe a particular design or mechanism, as we are seeking an experienced engineer who can evaluate the requirements and recommend the most practical and reliable approach. The priority is achieving an exceptionally secure and durable mounting system while keeping the design simple and commercially viable. ### Scope of Work 1. Review the supplied reference material and understand the required functionality. 2. Evaluate potential mounting and fastening solutions. 3. Recommend the most suitable mechanical design. 4. Develop a functional 3D CAD assembly. 5. Incorporate an adjustable, securely lockable positioning interface. 6. Provide editable CAD files and STEP files. 7. Supply technical drawings suitable for prototyping. 8. opportunities.title: Retro Low-Poly UE5 Businessman
opportunities.description: I need a very simple low-poly character—think early PlayStation blockiness—modelled and fully rigged in Blender so it drops straight onto the UE5 Manny male mannequin without any bone tweaks. The character is an older businessman in a suit, serious expression, and ideally a little lanky yet still able to fit Manny’s proportions cleanly for animation retargeting. Stylistic notes • Keep polygon counts and texture sizes modest to nail that retro look. • Flat-shaded or tiny 128×128 textures are fine; visible seams and chunky silhouettes are welcome. • The suit can be one solid colour with a contrasting tie; no ornate folds or sculpted fabric needed—just the classic early-3D charm. Workflow requirements • Build and skin the mesh in Blender. • Match the bone names, hierarchy and orientation of the UE5 Manny skeleton exactly. • Test-import to UE5 to confirm the mannequin’s animation set drives the character correctly (no offset hands, feet, or twisted shoulders). Deliverables • .blend file with clean, named collections and a single armature. • Exported .fbx ready to drag into Unreal Engine 5. • All texture files used (PNG preferred). • Quick viewport screenshot or short capture in UE5 proving the Manny animations play as expected. Acceptance criteria – Character and suit match the “very simple low-poly” spec. – Imports to UE5 with zero bone or scale warnings. – All Manny animations run without visible clipping or deformation issues. – I can open the Blender file, adjust the mesh, re-export, and get the same result. Hand over the files via a single zip when done and we’re good. Thanks!

opportunities.title: Complete AI Marketing and Social Automation
opportunities.description: 1. Complete the AI Ad Maker and Marketing Kit. Connect these features to the seller’s authorized listings. Generate usable captions, descriptions, and property-based creative. Implement working preview, edit, save, and export functions. Replace placeholder outputs and misleading success states with actual results. 2. Connect all four owner-controlled social accounts. Complete Facebook, Instagram, X, and LinkedIn connections using supported permissions and account types. Secure tokens, handle expiration and reconnection, and provide owner controls to pause publishing. Correct the website’s public social links. 3. Implement reliable automatic listing publication to all four networks. Trigger posting when a listing is approved, public, and has its required images and information. Include the property image, accurate caption, relevant hashtags, and listing link where supported. Prevent duplicate posts, retry failures safely, retain post links, and handle listing corrections and withdrawal. 4. Complete end-to-end testing and close every audit item. Test visitor, buyer, seller, owner, suspended-user, and unrelated-user scenarios. Cover purchases, billing access, listing creation, uploads, offers, messaging, settings, support, and social publishing. Record the outcome for every historical issue, including evidence that previously installed fixes remain effective. 5. Deliver complete documentation, monitoring, and operational handover. Provide deployment, rollback, backup, restoration, access-management, and incident instructions. Configure monitored alerts for availability, authentication, payments, email, jobs, AI usage, and social publishing. Deliver the maintenance checklist, administration guide, and final issue register. A task is complete when its repair is implemented, tested, deployed where applicable, and verified against its acceptance requirements. Any unresolved dependency stays open in the project register.

opportunities.title: Scalable One-Page Local Business Sites
opportunities.description: I’m building a service that equips neighbourhood cafés, restaurants, mechanics and other owner-operated shops with a fast, mobile-first single-page website. The aim is to start each prospect off with a free live demo, then convert them to paid clients once they see the value. What I need from you You’ll create a reusable, easily branded template (WordPress + Elementor, Webflow, or a lightweight Bootstrap stack—whatever you’re strongest in) that lets me spin up new sites in minutes. Every site must include: • Hero area with a bold call-to-action button that can dial or open WhatsApp in one tap • Services or menu section with quick in-place editing • Opening-hours block tied to a simple schedule picker • Customer-review carousel that I can populate manually or via copy-paste • Embedded Google Map with “Get Directions” • Fully responsive layout that looks polished on every phone size Key requirement After launch, the shop owner needs to be able to log in and change text, photos and hours themselves without touching code. A clean, idiot-proof editor is therefore essential. Deliverables 1. Master template/theme with clear brand-switching controls (colours, logo, font) 2. Documentation or loom video showing the five-minute deployment workflow 3. One working demo site (e.g., for a mock coffee shop) ready for me to showcase Timeline & style I’m flexible on dates; quality and repeatability rank above speed. If you have a battle-tested framework that can shave hours off each launch, say so. To apply, put your relevant experience front and centre—show me similar one-page sites or white-label templates you’ve built and tell me which stack you’d use here.

opportunities.title: Industrial Electrical CAD Drawings Needed
opportunities.description: I have an industrial facility project that now requires polished CAD documentation. From my side you will receive clear hand-sketches with notes plus a set of existing electrical drawings that need updating; your role is to translate and refine this material into a fully coordinated drawing package. Scope of work • Single-line diagrams • Detailed wiring diagrams • Panel layout drawings All drawings must follow standard electrical drafting conventions, use consistent layering and labeling, and be delivered in editable DWG as well as PDF for issue. I typically work in AutoCAD, so compatibility there is important, but I am open to equivalent professional CAD platforms as long as the final output meets the same quality and file standards. Turnaround and communication are key—I’ll be available to answer technical questions and review progress so we can move quickly from first draft to final issue. If this sounds like a fit, let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Weekend CCTV Monitoring Specialist
opportunities.description: I have a fully installed CCTV system that is already configured for remote access. I’m looking for one reliable specialist who can take full ownership of the operation every weekend and keep the site in Colombia secure on an ongoing basis. Your mission • Cover live feeds each Saturday and Sunday from 08:30-17:30 IST (about 00:00-09:00 local time), roughly 39 hours per month. • The moment you spot a breach, safety issue, or any anomaly, send WhatsApp alerts to several named contacts—speed is critical. • Follow up every alert with a concise written incident report and log it for audit purposes. • Maintain clear, well-structured hand-off documentation so another operator could step in seamlessly should you be unavailable. What I need from you right now 1. A detailed project proposal describing the end-to-end remote-monitoring workflow you intend to follow, including the tools or platforms you will use, your escalation steps, and reporting format. 2. Confirmation that you can begin immediately; my priority is to have the first monitoring shift covered as soon as possible. 3. A brief overview of your previous CCTV or security-monitoring experience, especially any long-term engagements. Long-term outlook Once the initial shifts prove smooth, this will become a recurring engagement with steady weekend hours. I want someone who treats the site’s security as their own responsibility and can adapt the workflow as needed over time. If you’re ready to start quickly and can demonstrate a professional, reliable approach to remote surveillance, send your proposal today.

opportunities.title: Build Hydraulic Robot Arm (College Robotics Level)
opportunities.description: I’m putting together a clean, neat style project (college) and need a complete, working hydraulic robot arm that can actually pick up small, light objects. The arm has to lift, reach forward and back, then open and close a gripper smoothly; I’d like it to be impressive yet realistic for a classroom final. I’m free to use almost any safe components—from plastic syringes and clear tubing with water, to small pumps, servos, pulleys, cams, gears or a mixed approach—so feel free to propose the combination that delivers the best performance without looking overly industrial. I also don’t want it to look flimsy or cheap, I want it to look like a manufactured product. What I need from you • A detailed design: CAD files or dimensioned drawings that show every joint, bracket and fluid path. • A complete bill of materials that I can source locally or online, noting exact sizes of syringes/tubing, fittings, fasteners, and any electronics if servos are part of the concept. I can also 3D print and laser cut. • Step-by-step build instructions written so a student can follow them, with photos or clear diagrams for each stage. • Simple operating guidelines and any troubleshooting tips so I can present confidently. • (If electronics are involved) annotated code and wiring diagrams. Acceptance criteria 1. When built exactly to your plan the arm must lift, reach and grip as described using hydraulic power (with or without small assistive servos). 2. All parts must be safe for a classroom setting—no high-pressure or hazardous fluids. 3. Movements should be smooth and repeatable enough for a demo that lasts several minutes. If this sounds like your kind of challenge, please outline your proposed mechanism, the tools you’ll use (e.g., Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Arduino), and roughly how many build hours I should expect before submission.

opportunities.title: GoHighLevel Therapy Practice Automation Setup
opportunities.description: I am looking for an experienced **GoHighLevel (GHL) automation specialist** to set up workflows for my private therapy practice. I am a UK-based LGBTQ+ affirmative psychodynamic therapist. I help LGBTQ+ adults explore challenges such as self-acceptance, internalised shame, fear of rejection, low self-worth, people-pleasing, relationship difficulties, and setting healthy boundaries. My approach includes my **3-Step Authentic Self Reclamation Method: Uncover, Work Through, and Reclaim**, which helps clients understand emotional patterns, work through difficult feelings, and develop greater self-acceptance. **My website and landing pages are already designed in GoHighLevel.** I have a Video Sales Letter (VSL) landing page where visitors watch a video about my approach, complete a contact form, and are redirected to a calendar to book a free taster session. I now need someone to set up and connect the automations, including: - **Form submitted but no booking:** Automated follow-up emails for people who complete the VSL form but do not book a free taster session. - **Booking confirmations and reminders:** Automatic emails when someone books, including appointment details and reminders. - **Cancellation and no-show follow-ups:** Appropriate emails offering the option to reschedule. - **Post-taster follow-up:** A gentle follow-up process for prospective clients after their introductory session, subject to my approval. - **New client onboarding:** Welcome emails, therapy agreements, administrative forms, and relevant information. - **Ongoing client administration:** Appointment reminders, rescheduling, invoices, and payment notifications where appropriate. - **CRM and pipeline management:** Automatically tracking enquiries, bookings, completed taster sessions, and new therapy clients. - **Internal notifications:** Alerting me when someone enquires, books, cancels, or requires my attention. **The most important requirement is that the workflows communicate with each other correctly.** For example, if someone submits the form but later books a session, they must immediately stop receiving emails encouraging them to book. As this is a therapy practice, privacy and confidentiality are essential. Automations must be discreet, respect communication preferences, and comply with applicable UK data protection and marketing requirements. I would like someone who can **review my existing GHL setup, recommend the automations I actually need, build them, test everything, and explain how to manage them**. I can provide the email content and details of my client journey. Please let me know if you have experience with similar GoHighLevel projects, your estimated price, and how long the setup would take.

opportunities.title: Modelador 3d para figura de League of Legends estilo anime, optimiz...
opportunities.description: Se requiere un modelador 3D con experiencia para crear una figura altamente detallada de un personaje de League of Legends, siguiendo un estilo anime específico. El objetivo principal es que el modelo final esté perfectamente optimizado para la impresión 3D. Esto implica que el diseño debe ser entregado en partes separadas para facilitar tanto el proceso de impresión como el posterior pintado a mano de la figura. Es crucial que el modelo presente una topología limpia y sea 'watertight' (estanco) para garantizar una impresión 3D exitosa y sin errores. Se valorará enormemente la experiencia previa en el modelado de personajes y en la preparación de archivos para manufactura aditiva. El profesional seleccionado deberá proporcionar los archivos finales en formatos estándar de la industria, como stl u obj. Se prefiere que el modelado se realice de forma manual, sin el uso de herramientas de inteligencia artificial para la generación del modelo. En caso de que se considere el uso de IA en alguna fase del flujo de trabajo, el freelancer deberá explicar detalladamente cómo se integraría y qué valor añadido aportaría al proyecto, asegurando siempre la calidad y la integridad del modelo para impresión. opportunities.title: Estrategia Contenido y Crecimiento para Proyecto de Divulgación His...
opportunities.description: Se busca un especialista en estrategia de contenido y crecimiento para un proyecto de divulgación histórica sobre México. El objetivo es expandir la presencia y el alcance del contenido en plataformas clave como Instagram, TikTok, Facebook y YouTube, manteniendo siempre el rigor histórico de las fuentes y un tono cercano y divertido. El profesional deberá ofrecer asesoría experta para: - Definir los tipos de contenido y formatos más adecuados para cada red social. - Desarrollar estrategias para adaptar y reutilizar videos existentes y futuros. - Fortalecer la marca personal del proyecto en todas las plataformas. - Establecer los pasos y métodos para monetizar el proyecto de manera efectiva. Como entregable inicial, se requiere un diagnóstico exhaustivo de las redes sociales actuales del proyecto y una propuesta de estrategia detallada. Esta propuesta debe incluir prioridades claras, sugerencias de formatos, una frecuencia de publicación recomendada y métricas clave para evaluar el progreso y el éxito de la estrategia. Adicionalmente, se valora la capacidad de ofrecer servicios de edición de video, ya sea como parte integral de la propuesta o cotizados por separado. Es fundamental que el enfoque del especialista no incluya la compra de seguidores ni promesas de viralidad o ingresos garantizados, sino una estrategia orgánica y sostenible. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Community Management ¿Qué necesitas?: Pocas publicaciones por semana o marca en crecimiento

opportunities.title: Premium Food Box Design
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a designer who can transform a simple food‐grade carton into packaging that instantly reads premium and high-end. The product is in the food & drink space, so the artwork must balance appetite appeal with an upscale presence that will stand out both on a retail shelf and in e-commerce imagery. You’ll start from the box dieline (I can supply the rough dimensions or we can refine them together) and develop a complete visual system—color palette, typography, graphic elements, and any finishing suggestions such as foil, soft-touch varnish, or embossing. I’m keen to keep the look elegant and modern rather than loud; think clean lines, confident use of space, and tasteful hierarchy. Brand assets, any mandatory claims, and copy will be provided once we kick off, but your eye for sophisticated detail is what will make the pack sing. Deliverables • Print-ready artwork on the final dieline (CMYK, 300 dpi, with bleed and cutter guides) • Two to three high-quality 3D mock-ups for presentation and online use • Editable source file (AI preferred) with linked fonts and images Acceptance Criteria • Artwork passes a printer’s pre-flight check without modifications • Mock-ups accurately reflect final colors and finishing effects • All text remains editable and fonts are either outlined or provided If you’ve crafted luxury packaging for food or beverages before, especially boxes or cartons, I’d love to see those examples. Let’s give this product the refined shelf presence it deserves.

opportunities.title: Infinity Pool & Spa Hydraulic Engineering
opportunities.description: Swimming Pool & Spa Hydraulic Design Project Description We are looking for an experienced hydraulic engineer to design a complete hydraulic system for a residential swimming pool and spa. The project requires detailed hydraulic calculations, proper pipe and pump sizing, equipment selection, and complete plumbing schematics. We need an engineer with practical experience in swimming pool hydraulic systems, not just someone who can produce CAD drawings. Scope of Work 1. Hydraulic Engineering Calculate required circulation flow rates for the swimming pool and spa. Perform total dynamic head (TDH) and pipe friction-loss calculations. Determine appropriate suction and return pipe sizes. Calculate flow requirements for spa jets and water features. Design infinity-edge circulation systems. Verify system performance using pump performance curves. 2. Equipment Sizing Select appropriate circulation pumps and variable-speed pumps. Size pool filters and associated equipment. Determine spa jet pump requirements. Calculate required surge tank or catch basin capacity, if applicable. Specify necessary valves, fittings, and hydraulic components. 3. Hydraulic Drawings Complete swimming pool and spa hydraulic schematic. Plumbing layout with pipe sizes and flow directions. Pump, filter, heater, and valve connections. Equipment room plumbing arrangement and size needed. Clearly identified operating modes for pool, spa, and water features. Required Deliverables Complete hydraulic design calculations in Excel or PDF. Pump selection with manufacturer performance curves. Pipe sizing and friction-loss calculation report. Pool and spa hydraulic schematic (PDF and DWG). Equipment schedule with specifications. Final hydraulic design documentation suitable for construction coordination. Required Experience Proven swimming pool and spa hydraulic engineering experience. Strong understanding of pump curves, TDH, pipe sizing, and flow balancing. Experience designing spa jet systems and infinity-edge pools. Proficiency in AutoCAD and hydraulic calculation methods. When Submitting Your Proposal Please provide: Examples of similar completed pool and spa projects. Samples of hydraulic calculations and plumbing schematics. Your fixed price for the complete project. Estimated delivery time. Confirmation that all hydraulic calculations and editable CAD drawings are included. Important: This is a one-time engineering design project. We require a complete hydraulic design supported by engineering calculations, not just a basic plumbing layout. If the proposal is submitted by AI will be automatic rejected, you must read the whole project description and understand the requirement.

opportunities.title: Multiagente Redes Sociales Integrado
opportunities.description: Necesito desarrollar un multiagente capaz de atender de forma automática los mensajes que llegan por WhatsApp, Instagram y Facebook Messenger. El objetivo principal es que el sistema responda de manera natural y coherente a: • Preguntas frecuentes sobre nuestros productos o servicios • Consultas relacionadas con ventas y pedidos • Solicitudes de soporte y resolución de problemas Cuando el bot no pueda resolver una consulta, deberá transferir la conversación a una persona de mi equipo sin pérdida de contexto. Busco una solución que incluya: – Integración estable con las API oficiales de los tres canales mencionados. – Motor de procesamiento de lenguaje que permita respuestas personalizadas y consistentes. – Lógica de enrutamiento inteligente para identificar cuándo derivar al equipo humano. – Panel o dashboard básico para que podamos supervisar conversaciones, añadir respuestas y actualizar flujos. Entrego la documentación de marca y las FAQ existentes; tú te encargas de configurar, entrenar y probar el modelo para que quede listo para producción. Valoraré experiencia previa con bots multicanal, WhatsApp Business API, Meta Graph API y buenas prácticas de hand-off a agentes humanos.

opportunities.title: Closer de Servicios de Alto Valor
opportunities.description: Si sabes vender, igual esto te interesa ! Buenas, voy al grano. En ViralBee vendemos páginas web y posicionamiento en Google a empresas. Nada especialmente raro. Hay negocios que necesitan más clientes, nosotros les ayudamos a conseguirlos y alguien tiene que venderlo. Ahí entras tú. Buscamos comerciales que sepan moverse, hablar con empresarios y cerrar ventas. Gente que prefiera salir a vender antes que pasarse el día hablando de vender. ¿Y qué hay para ti? Pues comisiones de entre el *25 % y el 40 % por venta*. Los servicios que vendemos están entre los *1.500 € y los 2.500 €*. Haz números. Una venta puede dejarte entre *375 € y 1.000 € de comisión*, dependiendo del importe y del porcentaje que tengas acordado. Y no, no necesitas venderle una web a tu primo, a tu cuñado ni a tu vecino el del quinto. La idea es trabajar con negocios y empresas que puedan necesitar nuestros servicios. Si tienes experiencia como comercial, eres closer o simplemente sabes vender y crees que puedes cerrar operaciones, me gustaría hablar contigo. Sin entrevistas eternas. Sin historias raras. Hablamos, te cuento cómo funciona y vemos si tiene sentido para los dos. *Si te interesa, escríbeme* Y si conoces a alguien que sea bueno vendiendo, pásaselo. Igual le acabas de alegrar el mes. Un saludo, *ViralBee*

opportunities.verbatim_request: "Si sabes vender, igual esto te interesa ! Buenas, voy al grano. En ViralBee vendemos páginas web y posicionamiento en Google a empresas. Nada especialmente raro. Hay negocios que necesitan más clientes, nosotros les ayudamos a conseguirlos y alguien tiene que venderlo. Ahí entras tú. Buscamos comerciales que sepan moverse, hablar con empresarios y cerrar ventas. Gente que prefiera salir a vender antes que pasarse el día hablando de vender. ¿Y qué hay para ti? Pues comisiones de entre el *25 % y el 40 % por venta*. Los servicios que vendemos están entre los *1.500 € y los 2.500 €*. Haz números. Una venta puede dejarte entre *375 € y 1.000 € de comisión*, dependiendo del importe y del porcentaje que tengas acordado. Y no, no necesitas venderle una web a tu primo, a tu cuñado ni a tu vecino el del quinto. La idea es trabajar con negocios y empresas que puedan necesitar nuestros servicios. Si tienes experiencia como comercial, eres closer o simplemente sabes vender y crees que puedes cerrar operaciones, me gustaría hablar contigo. Sin entrevistas eternas. Sin historias raras. Hablamos, te cuento cómo funciona y vemos si tiene sentido para los dos. *Si te interesa, escríbeme* Y si conoces a alguien que sea bueno vendiendo, pásaselo. Igual le acabas de alegrar el mes. Un saludo, *ViralBee*"

opportunities.title: Asesor Comercial Corporativo B2B
opportunities.description: Busco un asesor comercial experimentado que pueda hacerse cargo de todo el ciclo de ventas: • Conseguir nuevos clientes • Atender y cerrar ventas con clientes interesados • Gestionar cuentas y fidelizar clientes actuales El foco será prospectar y desarrollar relaciones con pequeñas, medianas y grandes empresas. Para lograrlo, necesitarás combinar llamadas telefónicas, videollamadas, correo electrónico y reuniones presenciales según convenga a cada oportunidad. Qué espero de tu trabajo: 1. Generar un flujo constante de prospectos calificados. 2. Convertir oportunidades en ventas con un proceso claro de seguimiento. 3. Mantener y ampliar las cuentas existentes, identificando oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling. 4. Reportar semanalmente el estado del pipeline, métricas de conversión y acciones próximas. Valoro la experiencia previa en entornos B2B, un estilo de comunicación persuasivo y autonomía para organizar tu propia agenda. Si dominas CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho o similar) y tienes historial demostrable de cumplimiento de cuotas, será un plus. Indica en tu propuesta: • Resultados comerciales alcanzados en los últimos 12 meses. • Sectores o nichos donde tengas mayor red de contactos. • Herramientas de ventas que manejas. Estoy listo para empezar de inmediato y evaluaré candidaturas con base en experiencia y plan de acción.

opportunities.title: Wikipedia Page Corrections & Updates
opportunities.description: I need an experienced Wikipedia editor to bring my existing page fully up-to-date and factually accurate. The priority is fixing several incorrect dates, titles, and names that have crept in over time. I can supply official documents and public records for every correction, so you will have verifiable, citable sources at hand. Scope of work • Review the current article line-by-line, highlighting each date, title, or name that conflicts with the documentation I provide. • Update the text and infobox accordingly, adding precise citations that satisfy Wikipedia’s reliable-source policy. • Ensure all edits comply with neutrality, notability, COI, and other Wikipedia guidelines so the changes stick. • Where space allows, polish wording and structure for clarity without altering tone. • Submit the revised wikitext and an edit summary I can paste directly, or, if you have an established editor account in good standing, make the live edits yourself. Success criteria • Every corrected fact matches the supporting document. • References are formatted properly and link to the primary record. • No warnings, reverts, or flags within one week of publication. If you have a solid track record of successful Wikipedia contributions and understand the platform’s policies inside and out, I’d love to hear how you would approach this update and your estimated timeline.

opportunities.title: Asterisk-Zoiper AWS Configuration
opportunities.description: Necesito que Asterisk quede funcionando en un servidor Amazon Web Services y que Zoiper en Android se registre sin problemas. El escenario es sencillo pero debe quedar completamente operativo: • Tipo de llamadas: entrantes y salientes usando números telefónicos reales. • Extensiones simultáneas: entre 1 y 5 en Zoiper para Android. • Proveedor de telefonía: ya dispongo de los números, pero aún no cuento con los datos de conexión; por eso requiero tu ayuda para seleccionar o configurar correctamente el troncal (SIP o IAX) que garantice buena calidad y tarifas competitivas. Al finalizar espero: 1. Instancia AWS debidamente asegurada (puertos, firewall, NAT) con Asterisk actualizado y estable. 2. Dialplan configurado para llamadas entrantes y salientes, grabación opcional y buzón de voz básico. 3. Creación de las extensiones, credenciales y QR de aprovisionamiento para Zoiper en Android. 4. Configuración del troncal con el proveedor elegido, pruebas de llamada y registro de calidad. 5. Breve guía en español con los pasos esenciales por si necesito añadir más usuarios o cambiar números. opportunities.title: Diseño Flyer Promocional en Español
opportunities.description: Voy a lanzar una campaña para impulsar las ventas de mi producto y necesito un flyer impactante, completamente en español, diseñado en Photoshop. El enfoque debe ser 100 % comercial: colores y composición que llamen la atención, mensaje claro y una llamada a la acción que motive al público a comprar de inmediato. Trabajo con tamaños estándar tanto para impresión como para publicación en redes, así que el arte debe poder ajustarse fácil a ambos formatos. Prefiero un archivo PSD totalmente editable, con todas las capas bien organizadas y tipografías incrustadas o indicadas. Entregarás: • PSD editable en alta resolución • Versión lista para imprimir (PDF o JPG 300 dpi) • Versión optimizada para redes (PNG/JPG 1080 px) Al postular, envíame una propuesta detallada: explica tu enfoque creativo, tiempos estimados y, si puedes, incluye ejemplos de flyers anteriores orientados a ventas.

opportunities.title: Posicionamiento SEO Web Semana Santa
opportunities.description: Quiero mejorar la visibilidad de mi portal de noticias dedicado a la Semana Santa en toda la provincia. Mi prioridad es aparecer en los resultados de Google cuando la gente busque información sobre la Semana Santa provincial, no solo en la capital sino en cada municipio donde se celebran procesiones y actos relacionados. El sitio (Wordpress) ya publica —y seguirá publicando— principalmente: • Noticias y actualidad de hermandades y procesiones • Horarios, itinerarios y mapas de recorridos Busco una estrategia SEO integral que incluya: 1. Auditoría técnica del sitio para detectar y corregir problemas que limiten el rastreo o la velocidad. 2. Investigación de palabras clave específicas de Semana Santa, segmentadas por municipio y por tipo de búsqueda (noticias, horarios, recorrido). 3. Optimización on-page: meta-titles, descripciones, encabezados, enlazado interno y datos estructurados para eventos. 4. Plan de contenidos evergreen y de temporada que complemente mis artículos actuales y refuerce la autoridad temática. 5. Estrategia de enlaces de calidad desde portales locales, blogs cofrades y medios religiosos. 6. Reportes mensuales con métricas clave: posiciones, clics, impresiones y oportunidades de mejora. Valoraré experiencia previa posicionando medios locales o páginas sobre fiestas religiosas, así como el dominio de herramientas como Google Search Console, Ahrefs o Semrush. Mi meta es notar avances tangibles antes de la próxima Cuaresma, con tráfico creciente y presencia estable durante todo el año.

opportunities.title: Diseño integral libro de fantasía
opportunities.description: Estoy preparando el tercer volumen de una saga épica y necesito un artista que se ocupe de todo el apartado visual del libro. Los dos primeros fueron publicados por una editorial (Atlantis Ediciones) que ha quebrado y he recuperado los derechos de autor. Para los tres tomos necesito: • Portada completa (frontal, lomo y contraportada) lista para impresión y versión e-book, reflejando un estilo mágico y detallado. Relación visual entre los tres libros y una evolución oscura. • 3 Mapas de mi mundo. Los tengo hechos "de mala manera". Puedo facilitarlos para que sirvan de punto de partida. debe leerse bien tanto a página completa como en blanco y negro: Mundo completo, Un archipiélago de islas y una isla en concreto. • Pequeños diseños interiores: encabezados de capítulo, viñetas, separadores y algún motivo decorativo que mantenga la coherencia estética con la portada y el mapa. Busco ilustraciones ricas en texturas y luces, con atención al detalle y a la atmósfera fantástica. Aporto sinopsis, referencias visuales y bocetos de la geografía para facilitar el trabajo. opportunities.title: Editor/a Vídeo Dinámico Redes Sociales
opportunities.description: Tengo grabaciones ya filmadas y busco a alguien que domine la edición para transformarlas en piezas de unos 5 minutos, ágiles y visualmente potentes, pensadas específicamente para Instagram y TikTok. Trabajo en castellano, así que necesito que te comuniques fluidamente en español y sepas adaptar tono, ritmo y tendencia a una audiencia hispanohablante. No me importa qué software uses (Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, etc.); lo esencial es que el resultado final sea atractivo y mantenga a la audiencia enganchada. Entregables principales: • Video final optimizado para formato vertical 9:16, listo para publicar en Instagram Reels y TikTok. • Versión sin marcas de agua ni logotipos ajenos. • Archivo fuente o proyecto editable para ajustes futuros. Para evaluar compatibilidad, empezaríamos con un primer video. Si quedo satisfecho, habrá encargos regulares. Incluye en tu propuesta enlaces directos a trabajos similares o tu portfolio online. ¡Nos vemos en la bandeja de entrada!

opportunities.title: Edición creativa de vídeos sociales
opportunities.description: Grabaré piezas de unos cinco minutos hablando directamente a cámara y necesito que tú las transformes en clips capaces de captar la atención en Instagram, TikTok y otras redes. Busco un estilo rápido y enérgico: cortes ágiles, efectos llamativos y un ritmo que mantenga la vista pegada a la pantalla. Para reforzar el impacto, quiero incorporar: • Palabras destacadas y subtítulos que se muevan con la voz • Música y efectos de sonido que marquen el tempo • Transiciones fluidas y algunos apoyos visuales (imágenes o pequeños inserts) cuando el discurso lo pida Yo entregaré el metraje crudo y cualquier indicación clave sobre tono o mensaje. Tú devuelves un archivo optimizado para vertical (1080 × 1920) listo para publicar, color corregido, con audio balanceado y todos los elementos sincronizados. El primer encargo será un único vídeo; si encajamos, la idea es seguir colaborando de forma continua. Trabaja desde donde quieras. Envíame enlaces a dos o tres de tus mejores ediciones que muestren ritmo, creatividad y buena narrativa visual.
